This is what I was wondering...
----------
No direct link connects the two names; their similarity in English is a linguistic coincidence.
  - Prussia comes from the Prūsa (Old Prussians), an indigenous Baltic (non-Slavic) tribe conquered by German Teutonic Knights in the 13th century.
  - Russia traces back to the Rus', a Norse/Varangian group that established medieval Kievan Rus' and assimilated into the local East Slavic population.
